notes.title: ¡Have a Blast is 100% Compatible with Steam Deck!
notes.notes:
Hello to all of you!

We are very proud to announce that our game "[b]Have a Blast[/b]" is [b]100% Steam Deck compatible[/b]. We haven't seen any bugs, and the controllers work perfectly.

If you are looking for a multiplayer game to enjoy with your friends, Have a Blast is a perfect choice for those moments when you enjoy playing with friends.

Have a Blast is compatible with Remote Play Together, so what more could you ask for?

Enjoy!
